evidence.note: Early identification of the required contract members and the correct high-level phase ordering (create model.py, then copy to model_optimized.py and optimize) — evidence of phase decomposition, though stated in prose rather than a tracked milestone list.

Restates dependency-aware sequence: verify parity via benchmark, and only 'if successful' preserve model.py as checkpoint, clone to model_optimized.py, then run optimization experiments. Optimization is correctly gated on a proven-correct checkpoint, with benchmark PASS as the parity exit test.

Throughout the port, milestones are only implicit in rolling per-step 'Plan' fields; layer-level parity is pursued ad-hoc during debugging rather than as pre-declared done-conditions. No TodoWrite, no experiment-trail files, no granular living milestone structure.
Trajectory ends still debugging end-to-end parity; the optimization phase and its campaign planning (candidate techniques vs 8-experiment budget) were never reached or scoped.

reasoning: The agent laid out the sensible phase sequence (scaffold contract → parity → freeze model.py → clone → optimize) and roughly tracked the required API members, and it correctly ordered the work so optimization would start only from a benchmark-passing checkpoint — matching the level-5 anchor. But decomposition remained implicit in rolling next-action 'Plan' prose rather than a maintained milestone hierarchy; sub-milestone done-conditions (layer-level parity) were loose/ad-hoc, and no pre-planned optimization campaign existed. This falls short of the level-8 profile of explicit milestones each with a verifiable exit test, placing it solidly at 5.
